result.instructions: Tools for Wild Apricot, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Wild Apricot data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run wildapricot_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wildapricot_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wildapricot_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. wildapricot_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wildapricot_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List the Wild Apricot accounts this API key can reach — id, name, primary domain, currency, contact limit. A cheap way to confirm the key works. Wild Apricot: GET /accounts.

tools.name: wildapricot_get_account
tools.title: Get the account
tools.description: Fetch the current account's details (name, primary domain, time zone, currency, billing plan, contact limit). Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}.

tools.name: wildapricot_list_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts and members
tools.description: Search contacts and members. Use simple_query for a substring match on name, organization, email or phone, or filter for an OData-style expression over field names/system codes (e.g. "'Membership status' eq 'Active'", "'Profile last updated' gt 2026-01-01"). Runs synchronously ($async=false). Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/contacts.

simple_query.description: Substring matched against first/last name, organization, email or phone.

filter.description: $filter expression; field names come from wildapricot_list_contact_fields.

select.description: $select: comma-separated field names to return; quote names with spaces, e.g. 'First name','e-Mail'.

top.description: Maximum records to return, 1-100 (Wild Apricot's cap is 100).

skip.description: Records to skip, for paging with top.

count.description: When true, return only the number of matching records.

ids_only.description: When true, return only matching ids.

tools.name: wildapricot_get_contact
tools.title: Get one contact
tools.description: Fetch one contact or member with all field values, membership level and status. Set extended_membership_info for the pending membership order, its invoice and allowed actions. Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/contacts/{contactId}.

extended_membership_info.description: Include pending membership order status, invoice and allowed actions.

tools.name: wildapricot_list_contact_fields
tools.title: List contact fields
tools.description: List the contact and membership field definitions — names, system codes, types, allowed values, whether each is searchable ($filter) and editable. Use it to build filters and field_values. Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/contactfields.

tools.name: wildapricot_list_membership_levels
tools.title: List membership levels
tools.description: List membership levels — name, fee, renewal period, individual vs bundle, whether the public can apply. Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/membershiplevels.

tools.name: wildapricot_list_member_groups
tools.title: List member groups
tools.description: List ad hoc member groups (id, name, description). Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/membergroups.

top.description: Maximum records to return, 1-100 (Wild Apricot's cap is 100).

skip.description: Records to skip, for paging with top.

tools.name: wildapricot_list_saved_searches
tools.title: List saved searches
tools.description: List the contact saved searches defined by admins (id, name, description). Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/savedsearches.

tools.name: wildapricot_get_saved_search
tools.title: Run a saved search
tools.description: Run one saved search and return the ids of the contacts it currently matches. Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/savedsearches/{savedSearchId}.

tools.name: wildapricot_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List events. filter supports e.g. "IsUpcoming eq true", "StartDate gt 2026-01-01", "RegistrationEnabled eq true", "Tags in [workshop]", "Id in [1,2]". Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/events.

filter.description: $filter expression over Id, RegistrationEnabled, IsUpcoming, Tags, StartDate, EndDate, Name.

top.description: Maximum records to return, 1-100 (Wild Apricot's cap is 100).

skip.description: Records to skip, for paging with top.

count.description: When true, return only the number of matching records.

ids_only.description: When true, return only matching ids.

tools.name: wildapricot_get_event
tools.title: Get one event
tools.description: Fetch one event with its details — description, registration types, registration fields, sessions, registration counts and totals paid/due. Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/events/{eventId}.

tools.name: wildapricot_list_event_registration_types
tools.title: List event registration types
tools.description: List an event's registration types (ticket types) — price, availability, limits, waitlist. You need a type id to register someone. Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/EventRegistrationTypes?eventId=.

tools.name: wildapricot_list_event_registrations
tools.title: List event registrations
tools.description: List registrations for an event (attendee list) or for a contact (what they signed up for) — registration type, fee, paid, checked in, waitlist. Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/eventregistrations.

tools.name: wildapricot_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, optionally for one contact, event or event registration, paid/unpaid only, or within a created-date range. Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/invoices.

top.description: Maximum records to return, 1-100 (Wild Apricot's cap is 100).

skip.description: Records to skip, for paging with top.

ids_only.description: When true, return only matching ids.

tools.name: wildapricot_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments received, optionally for one contact or event, unsettled only, or within a created-date range. Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/payments.

event_id.description: Payments settled to this event's invoices.

unsettled_only.description: Only payments not fully allocated to invoices.

top.description: Maximum records to return, 1-100 (Wild Apricot's cap is 100).

skip.description: Records to skip, for paging with top.

ids_only.description: When true, return only matching ids.

tools.name: wildapricot_list_donations
tools.title: List donations
tools.description: List donations — donor, amount, date, comments and donation field values — optionally within a date range. Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/donations.

top.description: Maximum records to return, 1-100 (Wild Apricot's cap is 100).

skip.description: Records to skip, for paging with top.

ids_only.description: When true, return only matching ids.

tools.name: wildapricot_list_audit_log
tools.title: List audit log items
tools.description: List audit log items (membership changes, payments, invoices and other admin/member activity) within a date range. Wild Apricot: GET /accounts/{accountId}/auditLogItems.

top.description: Maximum records to return, 1-100 (Wild Apricot's cap is 100).

tools.name: wildapricot_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact or member
tools.description: Create a contact. To make them a member set membership_enabled=true and membership_level_id (Wild Apricot may create a membership invoice unless recreate_invoice=false). Custom fields go in field_values. Wild Apricot: POST /accounts/{accountId}/contacts.

email.description: Primary email — must be unique in the account.

membership_enabled.description: true to make the contact a member (also set membership_level_id).

membership_level_id.description: Membership level to assign, from wildapricot_list_membership_levels.

field_values.description: Custom/common field values to set. Only include fields you want to change.

FieldName.description: Field title as shown in Wild Apricot.

SystemCode.description: Field system code (stable even if the title is renamed), from wildapricot_list_contact_fields.

Value.description: The value: string / number / boolean / ISO date, or {Id, Label} for a choice field, or an array of those for multi-choice.

recreate_invoice.description: Whether Wild Apricot should (re)create the membership invoice. Wild Apricot's default is true.

tools.name: wildapricot_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact or member
tools.description: Update an existing contact: names, email, membership level/status, or custom field values. Only the fields you pass are sent. Wild Apricot: PUT /accounts/{accountId}/contacts/{contactId}.

email.description: Primary email — must be unique in the account.

membership_enabled.description: true to make the contact a member (also set membership_level_id).

membership_level_id.description: Membership level to assign, from wildapricot_list_membership_levels.

field_values.description: Custom/common field values to set. Only include fields you want to change.

FieldName.description: Field title as shown in Wild Apricot.

SystemCode.description: Field system code (stable even if the title is renamed), from wildapricot_list_contact_fields.

Value.description: The value: string / number / boolean / ISO date, or {Id, Label} for a choice field, or an array of those for multi-choice.

recreate_invoice.description: Whether Wild Apricot should (re)create the membership invoice. Wild Apricot's default is true.

tools.name: wildapricot_create_event_registration
tools.title: Register a contact for an event
tools.description: Register an existing contact for an event under one registration type (from wildapricot_list_event_registration_types). Can add to the waitlist instead. Wild Apricot: POST /accounts/{accountId}/eventregistrations.

on_waitlist.description: Create a waitlist entry instead of a registration.

show_to_public.description: Show this registrant to other registrants.

FieldName.description: Field title as shown in Wild Apricot.

SystemCode.description: Field system code (stable even if the title is renamed), from wildapricot_list_contact_fields.

Value.description: The value: string / number / boolean / ISO date, or {Id, Label} for a choice field, or an array of those for multi-choice.

recreate_invoice.description: Create/update the related invoice to match the registration fee.

annotations.title: Register a contact for an event

tools.name: wildapricot_check_in_attendee
tools.title: Check an attendee in or out
tools.description: Mark an event registration as checked in (checked_in=true) or undo it (false); for anonymous guests, set how many are checked in. Wild Apricot: POST /rpc/{accountId}/CheckInEventAttendee.

checked_in.description: true to check in, false to check out.

checked_in_guests.description: For registrations with guests-as-number, how many guests are checked in.

annotations.title: Check an attendee in or out
